title: Support of source payloads
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine, let $x$ be a binary word, and let $t,B\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $t\le B$ and $|x|+1\le B$. For every integer $z$ with $z<-3B$ or $3B<z$ and every coordinate among the $k+1$ source tapes, the head-centered source payload of the configuration reached after $t$ steps from the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$ is the blank payload.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite binary Turing machine
t and B are natural numbers
i is a coordinate among the k+1 source tapes
replaced:
Let $M$ be a binary machine, $x$ an input, and $t, B$ natural numbers with $t \le B$
and $|x| + 1 \le B$.  Then for every integer coordinate $z$ with $z < -3B$ or
$z > 3B$ and every virtual tape coordinate, the head-centered payload of the
configuration reached by running $M$ for $t$ steps from its initial configuration on
$x$ is the blank payload.  This bound uses the initialized run, not arbitrary starting
configurations.
